observational_status: two independent sets of four matched native M3D-C1 cases at one fixed dt; no experimental shot, calibrated current integral, validated equilibrium/profile handoff or segmented controller-in-loop
successful_milestone: Eight normalized-native M3D-C1 cases completed in 625.40 seconds with exact zero-source equivalence and exactly identical raw jphi fields across independent fixed-dt repeats at t=0.01/0.02/0.03 on a matched 1004-element mesh. Deterministic fixed-dt repeatability is established for this configuration.
interpretation: The identical repeated fields exclude run-to-run variability as the explanation for result 135's large three-level timestep differences under the tested configuration. This is a reproducibility result, not proof of timestep convergence. Whether the unforced baseline or the driven response dominates the dt sensitivity remains unresolved.
followup_scope: One three-level unforced native M3D-C1 baseline jphi timestep-sensitivity audit, with same-mode zero equivalence, to isolate background solver dt sensitivity from commanded current-drive response dt sensitivity.
handoff_equivalence: unvalidated; same-mode zero-source equivalence is not experimental shot handoff
pb11_fidelity_limits: not_applicable; no p-B11 reaction, proton recirculation, radiation/electron loss, alpha transport/channeling, boron delivery, direct conversion, rotating plasma, rotation/shear, liquid lithium, ignition margin or net-power evidence
m3dc1_claim_boundary: Fixed-dt field repeatability of normalized-native M3D-C1 jphi only; e[2] uncalibrated. No numerical temporal convergence, physical current conservation, segmented-electrode authority, experimental shot handoff, causal TCT stabilization, p-B11 fidelity or reactor-net-power claim.
